scenarios.criterion: Every file under apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/ MUST use kebab-case name.type.ts naming: pages as *.page.ts, the site as magic-shop.site.ts, elements as *.element.ts.
scenarios.name: Site module files follow kebab-case name.type.ts naming
given: the ye-olde-magic-shop site module lives under apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/
when: the file names in apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/ (including flows/) are inspected
then: every page file is named *.page.ts, the site file is named magic-shop.site.ts, any element file is named *.element.ts, and the existing flows/draw-line.flow.ts is unchanged
no PascalCase .ts file remains anywhere in apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/

scenarios.criterion: Class names MUST stay unchanged and every import of a renamed file MUST be updated to its new path.
scenarios.name: Renamed site files keep their class names and every importer points to the new path
given: the site, page, and flow files under apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/ have been renamed to kebab-case
when: the exported class names in the renamed files and every file that imports them are inspected
then: each exported class name (for example MagicShop) is exactly the same as before the rename

every importer, including magic-shop.site.ts, flows/draw-line.flow.ts, features/support/world.ts, features/step_definitions/webapp.steps.ts, tests/cart.spec.ts, and tests/reagent-map-ui.spec.ts, imports from the new kebab-case path

a search for any of the old PascalCase import paths (lib/site/MagicShop, HomePage, CartPage, LoginPage, AccountPage, ProductDetailsPage, ReagentMapPage) across apps/ye-olde-magic-shop returns zero matches

scenarios.criterion: Every scenario that passed before the change MUST still pass after it, with no .feature file or assertion changed.
scenarios.name: Existing BDD and Playwright suites pass unchanged after the rename
given: the test:bdd Cucumber suite and the Playwright suite run via scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh were passing before the file rename
when: the same suites are run again against the renamed site files
then: test:bdd produces the same scenario pass count as before the rename
the Playwright suite run through scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh produces the same spec pass count as before the rename
no .feature file and no assertion in any .spec.ts or .steps.ts file differs from before the rename

scenarios.criterion: The developer stage MUST report this work in the exact field shape loom's state validator accepts, so a correct diff is not rejected a second time.
scenarios.name: Developer stage reports renamed files in the shape the state validator accepts
given: the developer stage has renamed the seven PascalCase site files to kebab-case using git mv
when: the developer stage records its filesCreated and filesModified fields for this change
then: filesCreated lists only the new kebab-case paths (magic-shop.site.ts, home.page.ts, cart.page.ts, login.page.ts, account.page.ts, product-details.page.ts, reagent-map.page.ts) and never an old path or an 'old -> new' pair

filesModified lists only plain paths for files whose imports changed but which were not themselves renamed (flows/draw-line.flow.ts, features/support/world.ts, features/step_definitions/webapp.steps.ts, tests/cart.spec.ts, tests/reagent-map-ui.spec.ts)
loom's state validator accepts the stage on this attempt
